data.cultural_impact: Vishwakarma is revered as the patron deity of artisans, engineers and architects. His legend is particularly significant in India and Nepal where the Vishwakarma Puja is celebrated with great enthusiasm by artisans and craftsmen. During this festival, tools and machines are given a ritualistic cleansing to invoke the blessings of Vishwakarma for a successful and productive year ahead.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Vishwakarma is not only revered for his creator role in the physical world, but also for his role in the spiritual realm. He is believed to be the embodiment of the divine power of creation, and his grace is invoked to enhance the creative potential of individuals. Additionally, Vishwakarma is also believed to be the guardian of knowledge and wisdom, and his blessings are sought for the attainment of spiritual growth and enlightenment. Thus, Vishwakarma holds a significant place in both the artistic and spiritual life of Hindus.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Devi Vishwakarma in Chennai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Vishwakarma, which means "Universal Creator". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Vishwakarma signifies the divine architect and creator in the Hindu pantheon. He embodies precision, craftsmanship, and the power to bring intricate designs to life. His name symbolizes the divine force that shapes and molds the universe.

Vishwakarma is a revered Hindu god and the divine architect of the universe in Hindu mythology. He is responsible for the creation of the world and all its beings. This name has a rich cultural and religious history and is popular among Hindus.

Origin: Vishwakarma is believed to have been born from the mind of Lord Brahma, the creator of the universe. He is considered to be the presiding deity of all artisans, engineers, and architects. His name means 'universal creator'.

Cultural and Religious Significance: Vishwakarma is celebrated every year during the festival of Vishwakarma Puja, which is dedicated to him. He is believed to bless his devotees with prosperity, success, and good fortune.

Appeal: The name Vishwakarma has a timeless appeal and is often chosen by parents who want to give their child a name with a rich cultural and religious history. It is also a popular choice among parents who are looking for a unique and meaningful name for their child.
